mcpPage.title: MCP
mcpPage.subtitle: Use Model Context Protocol inside ProjectPilot to connect third-party MCP servers and bring external tools and data into your workflow (same MCP ecosystem as Cursor, Claude Code, and similar hosts).
mcpPage.runTitle: Appendix: bundled MCP server in this repo
mcpPage.runIntro: The repo also ships an optional stdio MCP process (below) so external MCP hosts (e.g. Claude Code) can access this project’s registration data—that is separate from “bring other people’s MCP into PP.” From the develop-static directory:
mcpPage.toolListProjects: list_projects — list registered projects from projects/index.json
mcpPage.toolGetProject: get_project — fetch one project by key
mcpPage.toolDeleteProject: delete_project — remove a project from the registry
mcpPage.clientBody: To consume these tools from Claude Code, Cursor, or similar apps, add a stdio MCP server with the command and cwd above (develop-static, or any cwd where file-store resolves to the same data directory). See .mcp.json in the repo as a sample. Documentation for wiring third-party MCP servers into the ProjectPilot app itself will be added here as the feature lands.
mcpPage.dataNote: That reference server reads and writes the same on-disk project index as in-app Project management.
